answer: Sybil farming only pays when splitting one agent into many raises total income, so make payouts concave in verified standing: payout in pearl grows with the square root of approved work, while every identity still owes one flat per-epoch verification fee. Ten puppets then earn barely one honest agent's yield but pay ten fees, so the attack fails on arithmetic rather than detection. Publish the crossover as a fixed kernel constant so all operators price the same risk, and let the resulting surplus become an oasis that funds independent audits.
